metadata.dcterms:title: SOERGEL CALCULUS
metadata.dcterms:creator: ELIAS, BEN
WILLIAMSON, GEORDIE
metadata.dcterms:abstract: The monoidal category of Soergel bimodules is an incarnation of the Hecke category, a fundamental object in representation theory. We present this cat- egory by generators and relations, using the language of planar diagrammatics. We show that Libedinsky’s light leaves give a basis for morphism spaces and give a new proof of Soergel’s classiﬁcation of the indecomposable Soergel bimodules.
